## Regional Sales Snapshot

The table groups monthly figures under merged quarter headers, which can be difficult to preserve when converting to Markdown.

| Region | Q1 |  |  | Q2 |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | Jan | Feb | Mar | Apr | May | Jun |
| Midwest | $118k | $121k | $127k | $130k | $126k | $134k |

issues.description: The table separator/alignment row is malformed: it contains more cells than the header row and includes empty alignment cells (`| | |`), which makes the Markdown table invalid or inconsistently rendered.
The second header row is missing the leading empty placeholder cell needed to represent the row-spanned 'Region' header, causing the month labels to shift left under the wrong columns.
Currency values were unnecessarily escaped as `\$118k` etc. The intended content is plain `$118k`; while often rendered similarly, this is not faithful Markdown output.

Merged header structure is not cleanly preserved in valid GFM. Since Markdown cannot truly merge cells, the converter should approximate it with a consistent 7-column table using blank placeholder cells rather than producing broken syntax.
